title: Homemade Apple, Oats and Cinnamon ( Cereal ) Porridge Recipe for Babies
title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए घर का बना सेब, ओट्स और दालचीनी (अनाज) दलिया रेसिपी
content:
I have heard that oats are really a portion of good food to introduce your baby when is has crossed her 6 months. Oats are a very healthy grain and make a portion of great first food for your babies.  A few days back, I decided to make oats porridge, to make it more healthy and tastier I added some apples in it. I added some clean cinnamon powder which I bought during my last visit to Chennai in nuts & spices shop. To my surprise she loved it. Cinnamon not only gives a lovely aroma to the porridge, but it also helps indigestion.

 

Things to remember:

1) I used instant oats since that is the only oats available in my place. If you can get steel-cut oats, then they are highly recommended.

2) You could add any fruits in this porridge that your baby loves.

3) Adding cinnamon is optional. You can leave it or simply add any other spices like cardamom,

4) If you are afraid, whether oats/oatmeal cause constipation in babies. In my opinion and experience, oats/oatmeal won't cause constipation.

5) Puree the oats porridge finely or to the texture, you like to feed your baby.

6) If your apples are too sweet and you find your porridge to be sweet enough. Then don't add any sugar. 

7) I am not feeding oats daily to maha. I give ragi porridge one day, the next day I feed raw banana powder porridge(recipe soon), then the next day I give her oats porridge. So she doesn’t feel bored with the same food. 

8) I recommend you to start oatmeal on the 6th month of your baby.

 

How to make porridge:

 

Ingredients:

 

Oats – 1.5 tablespoon

Apple – 1/2 a big apple

Cinnamon Powder – 1/4 tsp

Water – 1/2 cup or adjust

 

Method:

 

Start by peeling and chopping 1/2 an apple into small pieces.

Take a clean saucepan, in which you cook your baby's food. Add oats, chopped apple, cinnamon and clean water in it.

Put the saucepan on the stove and cook it for 3 to 4 mins on a low flame till the oats are completely cooked.

Now take it off the stove and let it cool a bit. Pour the whole mix in a blender and make it into a smooth puree. 

Pour the porridge on to clean sterilized bowls and feed your baby. You

can pour this into a feeding bottle and feed your baby. I cut a bigger

hole in my feeding bottle nipple and feed my baby, this way it is easy

and convenient.
content_hi:
मैंने सुना है कि जई वास्तव में आपके बच्चे को पेश करने के लिए अच्छे भोजन का एक हिस्सा है जब उसने 6 महीने पार कर लिए हैं। ओट्स एक बहुत ही स्वास्थ्यवर्धक अनाज है और आपके शिशुओं के लिए बहुत अच्छा भोजन है। कुछ दिन पहले, मैंने जई का दलिया बनाने का फैसला किया, इसे और अधिक स्वस्थ और स्वादिष्ट बनाने के लिए मैंने इसमें कुछ सेब जोड़े। मैंने कुछ साफ दालचीनी पाउडर को जोड़ा जो मैंने अपनी पिछली यात्रा के दौरान नट्स और मसालों की दुकान में चेन्नई में खरीदा था। मेरे आश्चर्य करने के लिए वह इसे प्यार करता था। दालचीनी न केवल दलिया को एक सुंदर सुगंध देता है, बल्कि यह अपच में भी मदद करता है।

 

याद रखने वाली चीज़ें:

1) मैंने तत्काल जई का उपयोग किया है, क्योंकि मेरे स्थान पर एकमात्र जई उपलब्ध है। यदि आप स्टील-कट वाले जई प्राप्त कर सकते हैं, तो वे अत्यधिक अनुशंसित हैं।

2) आप इस दलिया में कोई भी फल मिला सकते हैं जो आपके बच्चे को पसंद है।

3) दालचीनी जोड़ना वैकल्पिक है। आप इसे छोड़ सकते हैं या इलायची जैसे किसी भी अन्य मसाले को जोड़ सकते हैं,

4) यदि आप डरते हैं, तो क्या ओट्स / दलिया शिशुओं में कब्ज पैदा करता है। मेरी राय और अनुभव में, जई / दलिया कब्ज का कारण नहीं होगा।

5) जई के दलिया को बारीक या बनावट में शुद्ध करें, आप अपने बच्चे को खिलाना पसंद करते हैं।

6) यदि आपके सेब बहुत अधिक मीठे हैं और आपको अपना दलिया पर्याप्त मीठा लगता है। फिर कोई चीनी न डालें।

7) मैं रोजाना ओट्स नहीं खिलाता हूं। मैं एक दिन रागी दलिया देता हूं, अगले दिन मैं कच्चे केले का पाउडर दलिया (जल्द ही पकाने की विधि) खिलाता हूं, फिर अगले दिन मैं उसे जई का दलिया देता हूं। इसलिए वह एक ही भोजन से ऊब महसूस नहीं करती।

8) मैं आपको अपने बच्चे के 6 वें महीने पर दलिया शुरू करने की सलाह देता हूं।

 

दलिया कैसे बनायें:

 

सामग्री:

 

जई - 1.5 बड़ा चम्मच

सेब - 1/2 बड़ा सेब

दालचीनी पाउडर - 1/4 चम्मच

पानी - 1/2 कप या समायोजित करें

 

तरीका:

 

छीलने और 1/2 सेब को छोटे टुकड़ों में काटकर शुरू करें।

एक साफ सॉस पैन लें, जिसमें आप अपने बच्चे का खाना पकाती हैं। इसमें जई, कटा हुआ सेब, दालचीनी और साफ पानी मिलाएं।

सॉस पैन को स्टोव पर रखो और इसे 3 से 4 मिनट के लिए धीमी आंच पर पकाएं जब तक कि जई पूरी तरह से पक न जाए।

अब इसे चूल्हे से उतार लें और इसे थोड़ा ठंडा होने दें। एक ब्लेंडर में पूरे मिश्रण डालो और इसे एक चिकनी प्यूरी में बनाएं।

निष्फल कटोरे साफ करने और अपने बच्चे को खिलाने के लिए दलिया डालें। आप

इसे एक खिला बोतल में डाल सकते हैं और अपने बच्चे को खिला सकते हैं। मैंने एक बड़ी कटौती की

मेरे खिला बोतल के निप्पल में छेद करें और मेरे बच्चे को खिलाएं, इस तरह से यह आसान है

और सुविधाजनक है।

related.title: Tasty Oven Roasted Chicken ( With Vegetables ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी ओवेन रोस्टेड चिकन (सब्जियों के साथ) रेसिपी
related.content:
Delicious and very easy roast chicken with veggies tastes so yummy. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Healthy chicken with veggies.

This is an easy dinner or lunch to put together. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Once you assembled everything it takes around 40 to 45 mins to cook. The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them and the inside is so juicy.

 

Roast Chicken with Vegetables

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 5 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken, cut into 12 pieces

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Carrot - 2 chopped

Cauliflower - 2 cups

Onion - 1 chopped

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Garlic - 10 cloves with skins on

 

FOR SPICE MIX:

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 tablespoon

Chilli Powder or Paprika - 1 tablespoon

Salt - 1 tablespoon

Parsley - 2 tablespoons

Oregano - 1 tablespoon

Sumac - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Mix spice mix together and set aside.

Take veggies in a baking pan. Add spice mix and oil and toss well.

Place chicken over it and sprinkle with spice mix and oil and mix well.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 35 to 45 mins.

Remove and serve it.

related.title: Tasty Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe
related.content:
Delicious spicy chicken curry made using roasted spice masala and coconut masala which is so yummy with rice.

This chicken curry is made using roasted whole spices masala which tastes super delicious. The freshly roasted spices give so much flavor to the chicken curry and make it super yummy.

 

Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 1 hour

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 serving

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Fennel seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 2 teaspoons

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam - 1 teaspoon

Bay Leaf - 1

Cardamom / Yelakai - 5

Cloves / Krambu - 5

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Brinji Ilai / Pandan Leaf - 1

Chicken - 1 kg

Shallots - 30 peeled and chopped finely

Tomato - 4 to 5 chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Salt to taste

Tomato - 1 chopped for adding last

Curry Leaves a handful for adding last

 

TO ROAST & GRIND:

Dry Red Chilli - 10 to 12

Coriander Leaves - 4 tablespoons

Cumin Seeds - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper - 2 teaspoons

Curry leaves a handful

TO GRIND:

Coconut - 1 cup grated

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai - 1 teaspoon

Fennel Seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Heat a pan, add whole spices to toast. Cook till golden. Take it in a blender and puree till smooth. Set aside.

Take coconut, gram dal, fennel and grind to a smooth paste.

Now heat oil in a pan, add in whole spices, onions and cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and curry leaves and mix well.

Add in chicken and cook till 5 to 6 mins.

Add in roasted coconut masala and water. Mix well.

Add this in a pressure cooker and cook for 2 whistles.

Take it off the heat and open the cooker.

Add in potatoes and cook till it is done.

Add in coconut masala and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Take the curry off the heat and add in tomato and curry leaves.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Pepper Chicken ( Milagu )  Gravy Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी काली मिर्च चिकन (मिलगु) ग्रेवी रेसिपी
related.content:
Spicy black pepper chicken gravy goes well with roti, rice or idli or dosa too. This spicy chicken curry tastes super delicious and very peppery.

I have shared a few varieties of pepper chicken and mutton recipes here. But I haven’t shared the pepper chicken gravy which we simply love. I make this all the time. So here it is. It is not at all hard to make, it is super easy to make and taste simply amazing.

 

Pepper Chicken Gravy Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Bay Leaf - 1

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Green Chilli - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Tomatoes - 2 large chopped finely

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli powder - 2 teaspoons

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Coriander Leaves for garnishing

 

FOR ROASTING & GRINDING:

Oil - 1 tsp

Fennel Seeds / Saunf / Sombu - 1 tablespoon

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Black Pepper - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Seeds - 2 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large chopped

 

Instructions

Pressure cook chicken with a little salt for 2 to 3 whistles. Set aside.

Heat little oil in a pot. Add in spices and toast them. Take it in a blender.

Add onions and cook till golden brown. Add it with the spices and grind till smooth. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pot, add in onions, chilies and bay leaf. Cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and cook till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in the ground masala and mix well.

Add salt, turmeric powder, chili powder, and garam masala and cook till oil separates.

Now add in the chicken along with any cooking liquid.

Mix well and simmer till oil separates.

Add coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Nuggets ( Kids Special ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन नगेट्स (किड्स स्पेशल) रेसिपी
related.content:
Cheesy chicken nuggets will be your kid's new favorite snack. So delicious and these are pan-fried instead of deep frying so it is more healthy.

This is so easy to make, you can make a bunch of these and freeze them. So you can fry them whenever you need them. Many of my readers have been asking for toddler nuggets recipe. I made this for my little one and she loved it to the core.

 

Cheesy Chicken Nuggets Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Snacks

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken Breast - 2 cut into strips

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR CRISPY COATING:

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Cheese - ¼ cup grated

Dried Parsley - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

FOR BATTER:

Cornflour - 2 tablespoons

All-Purpose Flour - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for crispy coating and set aside.

Take all ingredients for batter and mix well.

Take the chicken and dip in the batter, coat in breadcrumbs.

Now pan fry till golden brown on each side.

Serve with ketchup.
